transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this review to get the inputs we need before I make a final disposition on the 480 castings from Cell 7 that are on quality hold. As you know, we had an abnormal cooling event during yesterday's run. Visual inspection came back clean — no visible cracks — but I want to hear from each of you before I decide whether to release these to machining. Let's start with metrology: do we have any dimensional or residual stress data yet? And maintenance, what's the status on the cooling system repair? Production control, I'll need to understand the impact on the schedule depending on which way we go.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I completed a dimensional review of all 480 castings this morning. 312 meet the flatness limit of 0.30 mm or less, but 168 measure above 0.30 mm and will need to be reworked before they can be released. The full report is finished but is still in the metrology report queue and hasn't reached your desk yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Elena, on the maintenance side: I inspected Cell 7's cooling system this morning and found that the cooling-fan belt is damaged and must be replaced before another production run. I confirmed with my maintenance technician that the replacement takes exactly 2 hours. The work order hasn't been entered yet, but I wanted you to have this information for your disposition decision.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Elena, on the production control side: I checked the machining schedule and confirmed that the 312 conforming castings can start machining at exactly Thursday 14:00. The 168 nonconforming castings must remain out of that machining slot. I received the scheduler's confirmation today, but I have not yet updated the production plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Ravi to expedite the full metrology report from the report queue to Elena's desk for the official disposition record.
Jo to enter the work order for Cell 7's cooling-fan belt replacement and complete the 2-hour repair during the planned production pause.
Marta to update the production plan to reflect 312 conforming castings starting machining at Thursday 14:00, with 168 nonconforming castings held for rework.
